scenario: A collateral management analyst at a prime brokerage reviews a hedge fund client's repo agreement collateral schedule, computes haircut-adjusted eligible collateral values against the fund's gross exposure, and generates a formal margin adequacy notice to determine whether a margin call is required.
info_flow: ub2-csv-data-analyzer reads the collateral position CSV and computes net eligible collateral and gross exposure totals → financial-calculator applies haircut discounts and computes the margin adequacy ratio (eligible collateral / gross exposure) → reporting generates a formal margin adequacy notice with the pass/fail determination.
